definitions.explanation: The process by which rural areas become more developed and populated, taking on urban characteristics.

examples.japanese: {都市化|としか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧な⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{都市化|としか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{都市化|としか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Nature is decreasing due to urbanization.

notes:
{都市化|としか} means urbanization — the process of rural areas developing into urban ones. Composed of ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧ (city) + ⟦{化|か}→化：09473_ka⟧ (transformation suffix).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都市化|としか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: urbanization advances
- {都市化|としか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: effects of urbanization
- ⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧な{都市化|としか}: rapid urbanization
- {都市化|としか}⟦{現象|げんしょう}→現象：02718_genshou⟧: urbanization phenomenon

USAGE:
Common in essays, news, and academic contexts discussing social change. Japan's rapid {都市化|としか} after WWII is a frequent topic.

RELATED 〜{化|か} TERMS:
- ⟦{工業化|こうぎょうか}→工業化：17504_kougyouka⟧: industrialization
- ⟦{近代化|きんだいか}→近代化：15055_kindaika⟧: modernization
- ⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧: depopulation (of rural areas)
- ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧: aging (of population)
